weighted_and_deformation.domain: integer polynomial roots modulo explicitly chosen prime powers
weighted_and_deformation.finite_uniqueness_convention: Nonunit Jacobian roots modulo p^N have p^s residue representatives in the ball; all agree modulo p^(N-s). This is not a claim of p^s distinct completed roots.
weighted_and_deformation.non_claim: Integral-coefficient test families do not cover arbitrary p-adic coefficients; infinite root uniqueness and analytic regularity require their separate proofs.

non_claims: General analytic regularity or native descent
